subject.title: feat: auto-detect provider usage and billing stats

question: Should OpenClaw accept provider-discovered usage hooks plus a structured provider billing contract and Usage dashboard cards now, and what exact public schema should that contract expose?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public plugin/manifest/provider semantics, credential-backed billing interpretation, and dashboard UX; the protected `maintainer` label also requires human direction before implementation is considered done.

options.title: Define the additive contract and land a fixed PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers approve the structured billing schema, provider discovery rule, provider coverage, and dashboard behavior, then land the linked PR or a narrow successor after blockers are fixed.

options.title: Split provider coverage from the shared schema
options.body: Track OpenRouter, Venice, DashScope, and other provider hooks as smaller provider-specific issues while this issue remains the canonical schema and dashboard contract discussion.

options.title: Defer dashboard expansion
options.body: Keep current CLI, status, and transcript-derived Usage surfaces as supported for now, and close or narrow the dashboard billing work after an explicit maintainer decision.

recommendation.title: Define the additive contract and land a fixed PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers approve the structured billing schema, provider discovery rule, provider coverage, and dashboard behavior, then land the linked PR or a narrow successor after blockers are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the issue and linked implementation candidate and is the clearest owner for the schema, provider coverage, and dashboard product choice.
